findings.title: The small-action button no longer aligns to the right after its parent becomes flex
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so its direct `button` is a flex item and its existing `float: right` is ignored by CSS. The button will be laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the right edge as before, which can visibly break the post-action row and make it overflow when the description is long. Give the button an appropriate flex alignment rule (for example `margin-left: auto`) rather than relying on float.
